meta.name: babysit
meta.description: Watch a pull request or review cycle until it is ready to merge. Use when asked to babysit, monitor, or keep checking PR comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 持续监控 PR 直到所有问题解决可合并
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要盯着 PR 等待审核通过或 CI 通过
copy.tagline_en: Monitor pull requests until all issues are resolved and ready to merge
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to watch PRs until reviews and CI pass

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会一直盯着某个 PR 直到它真的可以合并:轮询 CI 检查、读新评论和未解决的 review 线程、在聚焦提交里改掉真实问题并推送,然后重新检查。检查未过或有线程未解决就不停。
howto.when: 当你要求它 babysit、monitor 某个 PR,或持续检查该 PR 的评论、review 与 CI 直到问题都解决时触发。

say.text: 帮我 babysit PR #123,直到可以合并才停
say.note: 它会轮询检查、评论和 review 线程

say.text: 看看 PR #123 还有哪些未解决的 review 线程和失败的检查
say.note: 列出未解决线程与检查结果

say.text: 每 30 秒轮询一次 PR #123 的 CI,有新评论就说要改什么
say.note: 按你指定的节奏持续检查

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude stays on a pull request until it is truly ready to merge: it polls CI checks, reads new comments and unresolved review threads, fixes real issues in focused commits, pushes, then checks again. It keeps going while checks fail or threads stay unresolved.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask it to babysit or monitor a pull request, or to keep checking that PR's comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

say_en.text: Babysit PR #123 until it is ready to merge
say_en.note: It polls checks, comments, and review threads

say_en.text: Show unresolved review threads and failing checks on PR #123
say_en.note: Lists unresolved threads and check results

say_en.text: Poll PR #123's CI every 30 seconds and flag new comments
say_en.note: Keeps watching at your chosen cadence
